assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production room master for The Ninth Tide, R05 Kitchen and Mess. Reference image is STYLE ONLY, a different room. Create a new abandoned 1931 coastal survey station communal kitchen, flat straight-on wall elevation, landscape 4:3 at same 1448x1086 proportions. Fine dark navy ink contours, broad matte sea-glass green, cream, muted ochre, dark petrol blue, tarnished brass and worn oak, subtle restrained paper texture. No photorealism, no angled walls or receding tabletop planes. Composition: far-left closed narrow petrol-blue service door. Left-middle a squat old black iron cooking range with a simple vertical stovepipe and a lidded tarnished copper stockpot. Above middle a small wooden kitchen service board with blank cream record card and two small token recesses. A large sea window dominates the upper-right half, straight-on thick dark blue frame, rain on panes, a distant low coast and lighthouse under low gray cloud. A small warm suspended enamel pendant lights the working area. Across the lower middle and right a long worn oak mess table seen strictly from the front, almost no top plane, front apron and two sturdy legs. Over the table a narrow pale linen cloth. EIGHT humble cream enamel soup bowls lined across it, subtle dark blue rims, worn but cared for. One empty setting gap among them feels conspicuous, nine faint spoon-shaped depressions in cloth (exact clue lettering will be supplied later, no need generated words). Folded kitchen towel at left end, closed dark-green provisioning ledger at right end, a plain wooden service drawer under left half of table with small brass pull. Background practical wall shelf with spare plates and ladle, one low apron hook with empty faded apron. Domestic, intimate, still; someone has just stopped making supper. No people, no ghosts, no horns, no occult icons, no skulls. The room should feel personal and unsettling through absence. Do NOT duplicate recorder, noticeboard photograph, headphones, stool or arrangement from reference. No repaired cup, that canonical prop lives in another room. No map in this room. All paper surfaces blank or restrained non-legible marks, exact text will be authored later. Keep every object separated enough for clickable extraction and preserve wide window as major story surface.
